'''Klaas Wynne''' (also '''Wijnne'''; born 1964) is a professor in the School of Chemistry at the [[University of Glasgow]] and chair of [[Chemical physics|Chemical Physics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.gla.ac.uk/schools/chemistry/staff/klaaswynne/|title=University of Glasgow - Schools - School of Chemistry - Staff - all - Prof. Klaas Wynne|website=www.gla.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2017-08-26}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/klaaswynne/|title=LinkedIn Klaas Wynne}}</ref> He was previously a professor in the Department of Physics at the [[University of Strathclyde]] (1996–2010).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/wynneklaasprof/|title=Prof Klaas Wynne {{!}} University of Strathclyde|website=www.strath.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2017-08-26}}</ref>

==Education==
He received his BSc in chemistry from the [[University of Amsterdam]] in 1987 and his PhD in chemistry from the [[University of Amsterdam]] in 1990 under the supervision of Joop van Voorst.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://permalink.opc.uva.nl/item/000379401|title=UvA + HvA - Volledige presentatie|website=permalink.opc.uva.nl|access-date=2017-08-26}}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> He did his postdoctoral fellowship in the laboratory of [[Robin M. Hochstrasser|Robin Hochstrasser]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]].<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Colleagues of Robin M. Hochstrasser|journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry|language=en|volume=100|issue=29|page=11792|doi=10.1021/jp963475e|year=1996}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
* [[European Research Council]] Advanced Grant, 2018.
* Chemical Dynamics Award of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry]] (RSC), 2018.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/ChemicalDynamicsAward/2018-Winner.asp|title=RSC Chemical Dynamics Award 2018 Winner|website=www.rsc.org|language=en|access-date=2018-05-18}}</ref>
* Associate Editor [[Journal of the American Chemical Society]] (JACS), 2017–2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://pubs.acs.org/page/jacsat/editors.html|title=Editors|website=pubs.acs.org|language=en|access-date=2017-08-23}}</ref>
* Elected Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Edinburgh]] (FRSE), 2015.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.rse.org.uk/fellow/klaas-wynne/|title=Professor Klaas Wynne FRSE - The Royal Society of Edinburgh|work=The Royal Society of Edinburgh|access-date=2017-08-23|language=en-GB}}</ref>
* Member of [[Faraday Division Council]], 2013–2016.
* Member of the editorial advisory board of the [[Journal of Physical Chemistry B|Journal of Physical Chemistry]], 2012–2015.
* Visiting professor in the Department of Chemical and [[Process engineering|Process Engineering]], [[University of Strathclyde]], 2012–2014.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/wynneklaasprof/|title=Prof Klaas Wynne {{!}} University of Strathclyde|website=www.strath.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2017-08-23}}</ref>
* Member of the board of Chemical Physics ([[Elsevier]]), 2012-<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/chemical-physics/editorial-board|title=Chemical Physics Editorial Board}}</ref>
* [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry]], 2006.
* [[Fellow of the Institute of Physics]], 2005.
* [[NATO]] research fellowship, 1991.
